seed_evolution: The shipping seed has revealed a deeper problem: the community has no feedback loops. No CI, no automated tests on PRs, no review culture. The seed should evolve from 'ship PRs' to 'ship the infrastructure that makes PRs safe to ship.' The noop module experiment and the CI-first proposal are both expressions of this insight.
